Apple___Apple_scab.cause: Fungal disease caused primarily by Venturia inaequalis.
symptoms: Olive-green to brown velvety spots on leaves or fruit
Severe infections can cause leaf drop
Fruit may develop scabby, corky lesions
favorable_conditions: Frequent rainfall or prolonged leaf wetness
Dense foliage with poor air circulation
precautions: Remove fallen infected leaves where practical
Avoid prolonged leaf wetness from irrigation
management: Use sanitation and pruning to reduce disease pressure
Monitor weather and disease development
Use locally recommended fungicides according to the product label when necessary
prevention: Use an integrated apple-scab management program

management: Remove infected fruit and wood
Maintain orchard sanitation
Use locally recommended fungicide programs where appropriate
prevention: Maintain tree vigor and balanced nutrition

Manage nearby alternate hosts when feasible and permitted
Use locally recommended fungicides when warranted
prevention: Choose resistant or less-susceptible cultivars where available
Follow local disease forecasting and management recommendations
